title: America needs to stop getting shocked by Chinese AI
slides: Why does every Chinese AI breakthrough still surprise America?

You now face competitors who innovate cheaper, faster, and quieter.
Stop reacting—start monitoring Chinese papers and open-source releases today.
thread_text:
1. Why still surprised?

DeepSeek's R1 matches top-tier reasoning but used 90% less compute than frontier models.

They trained R1 with reinforcement learning, bypassing the data-guzzling approach US labs rely on.

Your competitors now ship AI breakthroughs cheaper and faster while you fund bigger clusters.

4. Silent edge
